title: Shraddha
filler: Grief hadn’t found the door yet. I made myself too busy to answer it anyway.

blocks.text: It is possible to be grieving and also delighted by pavement.

title: Backlog
filler: RJ made the calls on what stayed and what went. I built the piles he had to stand in front of.

blocks.text: There is something strange about producing a document to prove you aren’t running a scam with your father-in-law’s death.

title: Silk
filler: RJ and I didn’t learn until after she was gone that she didn’t like potatoes. She made them anyway, for years.

blocks.text: A whole life accumulates like that — not by decision, but by not-finding.

title: Cul-de-sacs
filler: Mom’s kitchen was perfectly fine. It just wasn’t mine.

blocks.text: Even the house I was living in, I could only find by its labels.
